title: How Does ChatGPT Actually Work? It Guesses One Word
description:
ChatGPT does not look up the answer; it guesses the next word, again and again. See the one loop behind every reply, how it learned, why it can sound sure and be wrong, and the 2017 idea that started it. #Shorts #AI #ChatGPT

Up next: Why does ChatGPT make things up?
